goal: Design a LangGraph parity prototype that mirrors NativeAgentRuntimeV2 capabilities without editing source files, activating LangGraph as default, or weakening governance.
design_principles: Native V2 remains the canonical backend; LangGraph is a separately compilable parity target.
All governance, tool-gateway, memory-gateway, trace, and checkpoint contracts must be preserved exactly.
capability_metadata returned by /v2/chat/agent must remain byte-identical in keys and semantics.
No production route wiring changes; /v2/chat/agent continues to use get_agent_runtime_v2() -> NativeAgentRuntimeV2.
The LangGraph parity prototype is a design/blueprint only; no source edits in this front.
Future implementation should be gated by a runtime feature flag (e.g., AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph_parity) and reversible in one commit.

nodes.description: Validate mode, hash run_id, set version, persist run.json, emit trace, save checkpoint.
Load recent user turns and follow-up signals.
Intent detection, route selection, context inheritance.
For operational_agent/mixed_brain_reasoning build deterministic plan; for brain_evidence build evidence plan; direct_assistant/promotion_adapter skip to finalization.
Detect write-intent escalation, set confirmation_id and blocked tool scope.
Execute planned tools via ToolGatewayV2, respecting governance blocks and mode. Each tool call must update step status.
nodes.langgraph_node_type: plain node (sequential) or conditional edge loop

nodes.description: If zero grep/semantic hits or unresolved paths, append fallback tools and re-execute.
Call finalizer with correct template override and capability metadata derivation.
Persist run.json, checkpoint.json, trace events after every state transition.
nodes.langgraph_node_type: plain node (can be inlined into each node)

conditional_route_table.direct_assistant: Skip planner/tools; call finalizer with template_override='direct_assistant'.
conditional_route_table.promotion_adapter_dry_run: Build single promotion_candidate_validate step, execute, then finalize with template_override='promotion_adapter_dry_run'.
conditional_route_table.brain_evidence: Use evidence_sources to build evidence plan, execute, adapt, finalize with template_override='brain_evidence'.
conditional_route_table.mixed_brain_reasoning: Add generic reasoning step + evidence plan, execute, adapt, finalize with template_override='mixed_brain_reasoning'.
conditional_route_table.operational_agent: Use planner.build_plan, optionally enrich with evidence_sources, execute, adapt, finalize with default template.

memory_gateway.langgraph_integration: Instantiate MemoryGatewayV2 in graph state builder; expose as graph config or state field; invoke semantic_retrieve inside execute_tools node for steps with tool_name='semantic_retrieve'.

tool_gateway.langgraph_integration: Instantiate ToolGatewayV2 in graph state builder; use ToolCallRequest/ToolCallResult schemas in execute_tools node; call tools.call(request, mode=state.mode).
parity_requirements: Write tools blocked outside build mode or without approval token

governance.langgraph_integration: Call validate_mode, mode_requires_escalation, contains_forbidden_request_fields in nodes; keep write_allowed check inside write-tool execution.

trace.langgraph_integration: Wrap each node with a TraceStore.append on entry/exit; sanitize payloads with RAW_COT_MARKERS.

checkpoint.langgraph_integration: Use langgraph.checkpoint.sqlite.SqliteSaver or MemorySaver only as a secondary resumability layer; primary checkpoint remains CheckpointStore JSON with identical schema.
parity_requirements: LangGraph checkpointer is additive, not replacement

finalizer.langgraph_integration: Call finalize_agent_run from finalize node; pass correct template_override based on intent_route; preserve provider fallback chain and COT blocking.
parity_requirements: Template overrides: direct_assistant, brain_evidence, mixed_brain_reasoning, promotion_adapter_dry_run

capability_metadata_derivation_spec.description: api_adapter._build_capability_metadata must be reused verbatim; the LangGraph parity runtime must populate identical keys from the final state.

mapping.retrieval_no_results: any semantic step output.result.hits is empty
mapping.retrieval_skipped: not retrieval_attempted and intent_route not in {direct_assistant, promotion_adapter_dry_run}
mapping.planner_used: bool(plan) and any(step.tool_name for step in plan)
mapping.tools_considered: len([s for s in plan if s.tool_name])
mapping.tools_executed: len([s for s in plan if s.status in (completed, failed, blocked)])

implementation_phases.name: Flag-gated skeleton
implementation_phases.goal: Create a new LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 class behind AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph_parity without touching runtime.py default.
acceptance_criteria: graph.invoke accepts a goal and returns state with run_id

implementation_phases.name: Tool and memory wiring
implementation_phases.goal: Implement execute_tools node using ToolGatewayV2 and MemoryGatewayV2 with governance pre-check.
acceptance_criteria: read-only tools execute and return ToolCallResult dicts
write tools blocked in read_only mode

implementation_phases.name: Intent, planning, evidence parity
implementation_phases.goal: Wrap AgentV2IntentAdapter, build_plan, _build_evidence_plan, and adaptive expansion as nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Evidence sources produce same plan as native for same goal
Adaptive expansion matches native fallback behavior

implementation_phases.name: Finalizer and capability metadata parity
implementation_phases.goal: Call native finalizer and derive capability_metadata with identical keys/semantics.
acceptance_criteria: /v2/chat/agent (when backend flag set) returns same capability_metadata schema
Final answers use correct template override

implementation_phases.name: Trace and checkpoint parity
implementation_phases.goal: Persist run.json, checkpoint.json, trace.jsonl exactly like native; add optional LangGraph checkpointer.
acceptance_criteria: run.json diff against native is limited to backend field

implementation_phases.name: Isolated smoke parity test
implementation_phases.goal: Create tests/smoke/test_brain_langgraph_parity_runtime_05.py comparing native and langgraph parity outputs for same inputs.
acceptance_criteria: No production route wired by default

implementation_phases.name: Optional route wiring behind flag
implementation_phases.goal: Allow runtime.py to select LangGraphParityRuntimeV2 only when AGENT_V2_BACKEND=langgraph_parity is set; default remains native.

risks.risk: LangGraph graph state becomes the source of truth and diverges from native run.json schema.
risks.mitigation: Mandate native CheckpointStore/run.json persistence after every node; LangGraph state is transient execution context only.

risks.risk: Governance bypass through graph node ordering or direct state mutation.
risks.mitigation: Every tool invocation goes through ToolGatewayV2.call with mode parameter; governance checks happen before node entry.
Share api_adapter._build_capability_metadata helper; add smoke parity assertions.

risks.risk: LangGraph checkpointer writes to unexpected paths.
risks.mitigation: Use in-memory MemorySaver for prototype; SqliteSaver only with explicit tmp_agent/agent_kernel_v2/langgraph_checkpoints.db path and gitignored.
Mirror native loop: single expansion pass with at most one retry per trigger condition.
